update_procedure: Treat this file as the immutable starting-candidate record for HUI-A1.
When a fact changes before HUI1 closes, record the changed path, old value, new value, commit, owner, and disposition in the Phase 1 runtime inventory and receipt.
Never replace a starting hash silently; advance schema_version and record both the old and new digest if the baseline itself is corrected.
Reproduce git-tree digests from baseline.commit, not from a dirty working tree.
A missing path, count mismatch, ambiguous document class, or unowned exception keeps HUI-A1 merge-pending.
